# Charlotta

- **Age:** Fourteen to fifteen years old  <sub>[v1 c28 P8](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0008), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c28 P11](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0011), [v2 c21 P42](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0042)</sub>
- **Status:** Married  <sub>[v4 c3 P39](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0039), [v4 c3 P40](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0040)</sub>

- **Titles:** Charlotta the Fourth  <sub>[v2 c21 P44](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0044), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>

## Appearance

Charlotta the Fourth is a thin, awkward girl with a freckled face, a snub nose, and a remarkably wide mouth and smile. She has fair hair worn in long braids usually adorned with enormous blue ribbon bows. She takes great pride in her appearance, often attempting to imitate Anne Shirley's poise and style.

_Sources: [v1 c28 P30](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0030), [v2 c21 P39](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0039), [v2 c23 P0](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0000), [v2 c27 P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039), [v2 c30 P27](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0027), [v2 c30 P28](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0028)_

## Personality

Charlotta the Fourth is an energetic, bustling, and fiercely loyal handmaid who adores her mistress, Miss Lavendar. She is extremely hardworking and takes great pride in her domestic duties, although she can be prone to nervous anxiety and fears of things going wrong. Despite a tendency toward literal-mindedness, she is deeply affectionate, romantic at heart, and accepts the imaginative whimsies of those she loves without judgment. She holds a strong sense of personal independence and pride in her Island heritage.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c23 P0](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0000), [v2 c23 P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010), [v2 c27 P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044), [v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055), [v2 c30 P12](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0012), [v2 c30 P16](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0016)_

## History

Leonora Bowman, known exclusively as Charlotta the Fourth, was hired at age thirteen by Miss Lavendar Lewis to work as a handmaid at Echo Lodge in Grafton. Being the last of four Bowman sisters to hold the position, she inherited the customary name given by Miss Lavendar to her young helpers. She quickly formed a deep bond of love and loyalty with her mistress, indulging Miss Lavendar's imaginative nature without judgment. When Anne Shirley and Diana Barry discovered Echo Lodge, Charlotta welcomed them warmly and formed a special admiration for Anne, frequently attempting to copy her graceful gestures and speech. She played a key role as confidante and helper during the romantic reunion and wedding of Miss Lavendar and Stephen Irving. Following the marriage, Charlotta moved with the Irvings to Boston, where she occasionally suffered from bouts of homesickness for Prince Edward Island. She eventually married a bricklayer named Tom, and later returned briefly to Prince Edward Island to attend Anne Shirley's wedding at Green Gables.

_Sources: [v1 c28 P30](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0030), [v2 c21 P39](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0039), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c23 P0](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0000), [v2 c23 P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010), [v2 c27 P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039), [v2 c28 P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048), [v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055), [v2 c30 P12](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0012), [v2 c30 P28](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0028), [v2 c30 P33](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0033), [v3 c7 P48](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0048), [v4 c3 P39](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0039), [v4 c3 P40](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0040), [v4 c4 P16](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0016)_
